blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The canonical V2 vault's RESTRICTION_ROLE can apply full restrictions in the _update share-transfer hook, preventing transfers and redemption actions. It can relocate liquid shares or in-flight redeem requests from a fully restricted account to an unrestricted recipient. The complete deployment-to-block-26197360 role history and current hasRole identify the governance Safe as sole restriction-role holder; pinned runtime matches the verified implementation. This is a direct local holder-control surface, so reviewedStatus is true rather than inherited. Parent USDx adds separate upstream restriction and upgrade exposure.

oracleRisk.summary: StakedUSDx values shares using accountedAssets plus vested rewards, not an external market oracle or the raw token balance. Reward and accounting policy is governed, and the wrapper inherits the parent USDx offchain pricing and hedge exposures.

branchApplicability.rationale: The vault's exchangeRate determines deposit/share conversion and the assets reserved when shares are burned for an async redemption request. It is a price-sensitive top-level internal NAV authority. The savings vault creates no borrower-owned debt positions or liquidation markets and requires no CDP branch rows.
